areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Only historic-building revitalisation touches cultural memory; single non-SMART indicator; very small resource share; little impact; efficiency not confirmed.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly related; mobility and drainage components; relevant indicators with achievable targets; most resources go to the area; high impact; efficient but not innovative.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Two related specific objectives and a vegetation-cover indicator; small to moderate resource share for spring recovery and ecological parks; localised actions, low impact; efficient measures.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Urban and climate resilience objective with drainage and flooding indicators; relevant resource share; works concentrate on drainage without broad adaptation, so low strategic impact; efficient, not innovative.
